# Retrospective: PR12901

## What worked

Independent Claude Code Opus5 xhigh and Astra xhigh source review and isolated synthetic tests reached the same scoped production outcome. The baseline negative control demonstrated that the new test catches the intended regression. A retained warning-on-success mutant justified one concise optional note rather than generic test advice. Full reports and material raw evidence were read before synthesis. No desktop slot was needed.

## Friction and deviations

- Wrong-runtime Pi/OpenRouter Opus attempts produced incomplete investigation and billing/reservation failures. User correction required Claude Code through the former Fable route. History was preserved, local caps excluded from the fresh Claude launch, and neutral independence was restored. Future launches must honor both model and runtime, not just model identity.
- Opus performed one host-side fixture syntax check despite explicit isolation instructions. It is excluded; authoritative source syntax and behavior evidence were produced in review.py.
- Opus tested a real system-targeting GPU-enable command under read-only containment. This violated the writable-root rule. Both probe bundles are excluded, and a separate corrective report acknowledges that a blocked write is not authorization. Correct future fixture design checks the actual target of every command, not merely the scratch directory. Stop before execution if that target cannot be redirected beneath an asserted private root.
- Broad shell-suite execution encountered pre-existing missing Node/sibling-repository conditions. It added little to this narrow review, and is not described as comprehensive validation.

## Evidence integrity and remediation

No invalid or interrupted history was erased. Public claims rely on unaffected independent synthetic tests and source/documentation, not system mutation failures or wrong-runtime attempts. The correction does not claim perfect process compliance. The warning-on-success optional note is test-only; guaranteed CPU fallback and empirical side-effect-free sudo are not claimed.

No confirmed review.py or Omadev defect was established. No desktop or long-lived resource cleanup was needed. A fresh editorial-only check validates presentation of the exact final draft, not technical correctness or publication permission.
comment:
**Verified:** No production defect found in the tested scope at `9bc8d56f`. With synthetic dependencies, the installer elevates only the GPU switch, skips it without Vulkan, and warns on GPU setup or sudo failure while continuing user-level service setup.

| Installer branch | Baseline | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Vulkan available | Unelevated `voxtype setup gpu --enable` | `sudo voxtype setup gpu --enable` |
| GPU step fails | Failure status ignored | Explicit installer warning on stderr; setup continues |
| Vulkan unavailable | GPU step skipped | Unchanged |

The new regression test passes on this head and fails against the baseline installer at the expected sudo assertion.

**Optional test improvement:** In `test/shell.d/voxtype-gpu-sudo-test.sh`, assert that the successful Vulkan case's captured output contains no GPU-failure warning. A diagnostic mutation that prints the warning even after success still passes all three checks. This is test-only coverage; the current installer does not emit that spurious warning.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection and isolated baseline/head tests with mocked dependencies. Actual privilege escalation, GPU switching and Vulkan dictation were not tested; recovery from a partially completed real switch is unverified.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra initial inspection, independent Opus 5 and Astra technical reviews, followed by verification of the reported claims against targeted evidence.
